description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality and API methods of the I18NGroupAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It contains tests for retrieving all I18N groups and checks for not implemented create and delete operations.

classes.name: I18NGroupAPITest
classes.description: Test class for the I18NGroupAPI, extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase. Contains unit tests for API endpoints and validation methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the I18NGroupAPI, using data provider for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testGetAll' method, loading from YAML data source.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures the 'create' method throws a not implemented exception without performing an actual creation.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' is not implemented and raises the expected exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures the 'delete' method throws a not implemented exception when invoked.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' is not implemented and raises the expected exception.
